Part (b)
• Most responses used a calculator to find the correct value of ( ) 60 . a However, many responses did not provide the
setup for the response, i.e., ( ) 60 a is ( ) 60 . v′
• Several responses did not report any units for the acceleration, but most responses provided the correct units of
meters per second per second.
• A large proportion of the responses presented the misconception that the value of ( ) 60 a alone could be used to
determine whether Stephen was speeding up or slowing down.
• The responses that considered the values ( ) 60 a and ( ) 60 v were generally successful in reasoning that Stephen was
speeding up.
